header_summary:
The recent proposal for the CISA output type in cryptographic systems highlights its potential to enhance efficiency in post-quantum blockchain transactions by using minimal byte witnesses for aggregated elliptic curve transactions, promising better performance than existing models like P2TR. However, the adoption of CISA is challenged by the significant updates required in software and infrastructure and the historical resistance from users towards new technologies, coupled with concerns about the complexity of integration and the current low-fee environment which may deter rapid uptake [Read more on the discussion](https://delvingbitcoin.org/t/pqc-output-type-discussion/2749/6).

In response to security concerns, a new method for generating seed words has been developed, employing ordinary dice and playing cards to ensure offline, bias-free entropy generation. This system, detailed on GitHub, caters to users favoring tangible security methods and enhances transparency and user control in digital asset protection [Explore the repository](https://github.com/seed-cat/analog-seed-entropy).

Improvements to the JSON API have significantly boosted the reliability of cryptocurrency transactions, introducing features that allow users to preview and verify transaction clusters more accurately. Despite these advancements, there remains a discrepancy between backend improvements and user interface updates, highlighting ongoing challenges in integrating new features into existing systems [Further details](https://delvingbitcoin.org/t/deterministic-utxo-consolidation-under-volatile-fee-regimes/2257/5).

active_posts.summary:

active_posts.title: Running Core's real consensus code inside a zkVM
active_posts.summary: - Hazync innovatively proves Bitcoin's consensus without changing core rules using Bitcoin Core v28.  - The system ensures security by verifying block proofs without re-executing entire blockchain history.  - It offers a community-driven "Proof Party" and browser-based tools for independent proof verification.
